acquisition: Explicit publisher GitHub API over pinned original paths; historical local .jsonl names retained, original .json publisher payload bytes unchanged
input_fields: Original question plus every original document title/paragraph; no oracle passage selection or input truncation
non_input_fields_preserved: All other original top-level and document annotation fields, including question_type, fact_or_opinion, segmented question/answers/title/paragraphs, original rank, is_selected, most_related_para, answer spans/docs/strings, match scores, yes/no and entity annotations when present
unicode_separator_boundary: Original train contains literal U+2028 inside string values. Preserve physical JSONL records; str.splitlines is not a safe JSONL parser. No original bytes normalized or rewritten.
scope_limits: Publisher search demo train/dev100 each only; not the full DuReader corpus or Zhidao. Native task generation, publisher evaluation and environment/usage recipe remain pending, so no delivery tick. Earlier lossy mapping/prepared artifacts stay historical rather than relabeled.
